steps.note: youtube.com 在 BLOCKED_DOMAINS，create 里的 use_proxy:true 让整个会话走 AGINXBROWSER_PROXY（session 级 opt-in 全量走——这个流要的就是全量走）。软探测：ytInitialPlayerResponse 挂上或 12s 到点必真（wait 超时=fail 整流，#50 老坑）
detail 是字符串只能 contains（#50 坑）；boot 干净=true 跳 read，脏（12s 无 playerResponse：代理死/consent 墙/视频不存在）直落 takeover

args.script: throw new Error('youtube player response absent — url={{url}} boot=' + JSON.stringify({{boot}}).slice(0, 200) + ' — check AGINXBROWSER_PROXY egress / consent wall')

steps.note: 回执带 boot 事实。代理没挂/出口坏了是最常见原因

args.script: (() => { const pr = window.ytInitialPlayerResponse; const vd = pr.videoDetails || {}; const caps = (((pr.captions || {}).playerCaptionsTracklistRenderer || {}).captionTracks) || []; const pick = caps.find(c => c.languageCode === '{{lang}}' && !c.kind) || caps.find(c => c.languageCode === '{{lang}}') || null; return { vid: vd.videoId, title: vd.title, author: vd.author, lengthSeconds: vd.lengthSeconds, viewCount: vd.viewCount, keywords: vd.keywords || [], captionTracks: caps.map(c => ({ lang: c.languageCode, name: (c.name && (c.name.simpleText || (c.name.runs && c.name.runs[0] && c.name.runs[0].text))) || '', kind: c.kind || null, isTranslatable: !!c.isTranslatable, baseUrl: c.baseUrl })), picked: pick ? { lang: pick.languageCode, baseUrl: pick.baseUrl } : null, note: pick ? 'body fetch = pot wall, baseUrl delivered raw (see flow.md)' : 'no track for lang={{lang}}' }; })()

steps.note: 交付原料：视频全元数据 + 字幕轨全表（语言/名称/auto 标记/可翻译/baseUrl）+ 按 lang 挑轨。字幕正文四路实测全墙（timedtext 200 空 body、innertube ANDROID 400、get_transcript 400、DOM 无转录面板）=pot/出口信誉墙——baseUrl 原样交付，正文解码是另案（同 secfont：流送 token，解码离线）
